prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE game dialogue bust of Seldan Portão-Firme. Image 1 is this character's current sprite and primary identity reference: preserve face, hair, costume, species and accessories while translating pixels to a finished portrait. Images 2 and 3 define Coreto portrait STYLE only; do not copy their identity or equipment. Character source brief in Portuguese:


- **Papel:** Oficial responsável pela segurança dos acessos.
- **Raça, idade e aparência:** Orc adulto, cerca de 60 anos propostos. Pele verde escura, cabelo grisalho aparado, cicatriz no queixo; armadura funcional com pequenas placas substituídas.
- **Personalidade em uma frase:** Quer que a regra proteja quem não tem influência e às vezes a segue quando deveria questioná-la.


Specific portrayal: Mature male ORC official, neatly trimmed graying hair and chin scar. Upright vigilant pose, one hand resting over other at belt. Functional armor with replaced small plates, no invented rank badges.
Exact graphic language: bold clean black hand-inked contours, warm monochrome sepia/ochre/parchment palette, fine dense stippling and crosshatching, stylized fantasy cartoon anatomy and expressive face, matching Coreto references. Translate all species skin and hair colors into distinct sepia values. No photorealism, no 3D, no pixel art, no airbrush or full-color painting. Keep distinct species and age. Single head-to-waist bust, natural three-quarter view, complete head and both shoulders, forearms and hands inside frame with comfortable margin. Portrait-oriented canvas. No extra objects beyond sprite/brief, text, scenery, borders, glow, ground shadow or watermark. Genuine transparent background.
